verdict: APPROVE the gate source, decoder and built binary for the T2 packet. I found no path to a false READY or a false clean-absence 77 from an error, and no leaked right. Notes N1-N3 record limits and one classification choice; none blocks.
false_ready: Exit 0 needs all of the following: no reason, query error or release error; HID and serial walks done with no PDSerialHID; all four matching-iterator validity slots set; exactly one PDM1SPIHID and one PDM1SPITrackpad with distinct nonzero IDs; the recorded parent and child IDs equal to them; one provider, done, with valid parent-iterator slots and provider ID equal to the parent; COMPLETE; lengths 110/4/32; the descriptor equal to the approved 110 bytes; interface u32 = 2; state version 1, size 32, reserved 0, flags ≤ 1, and exactly committed 1, route_ready 1, faulted 0, stop_requested 0, last_error 0; and both nodes character devices. The classifier rebuilds this from the record alone and ignores what collect returned. The independent Python classify() reimplements every predicate, checks the descriptor by SHA-256, and also requires the reserved tail 694..703 to be zero. decode() requires the guest verdict, footer result and summary to equal its own classification.
false_77: 77 occurs only with no reason or error and a clean absence: no IOHIDDevice match (null successful iterator), parent or child absent from a clean walk, a well-formed non-ready state tuple, or a node ENOENT. Every RPC failure, invalid iterator, null port on success, EOF carrying a port, excess entry, unknown or duplicate class or ID, PDSerialHID instance, null or zero or extra parent, provider mismatch, short or long or zero-length property, descriptor or interface mismatch, impossible state tuple, wrong node type, stat error and release failure gives 1. The sequence checks PDSerialHID exclusion before classifying a clean absence.
ownership: keep() records every nonzero port before its status is examined, so a right returned with an error is still released. A null success from next is NG_NULL_PORT and is not treated as end. EOF needs kIOReturnNoDevice with a null port. The worst-case owned set is 10 of 16; the 16-slot overflow path releases immediately and flags ownership. Everything is released LIFO at done, the master port last; any release failure counts and forces 1. In the tiny library IOMasterPort is host_get_io_master (a caller-owned send right) and IOObjectRelease is mach_port_deallocate, and IOServiceMatching uses a static buffer, so nothing leaks.
real_main_and_sdk: main.c uses raw io_iterator_next with its status preserved (G1), io_iterator_is_valid, io_object_get_class, the registry ID, the IOService-plane parent iterator, and get_property_bytes with capacity 4096 in and count out (P2); the node check is lstat only. A bad CLI exits 2 before any RPC. The export is BEGIN, a public JSON line without registry IDs, 11 x 64-byte hex chunks, and END with SHA-256 and result. The immutable source holds exactly gate.c, gate.h, main.c, child_state.h and trackpad_reference.h at the pinned hashes, and the derivation has 5 sha256 checks. Imports are libSystem only. Reachability in a2d151f9, with main plus the ten ops-table wrappers as roots: IOMasterPort/IOKitEnsureTaskSelf, IOServiceMatching, IOServiceGetMatchingServices/io_service_get_matching_services, io_iterator_next, io_iterator_is_valid, io_object_get_class, get_registry_entry_id, get_parent_iterator, get_property_bytes and IOObjectRelease. None of the linked io_service_open, io_connect_*, set_properties or io_catalog_* routines is reachable.
independent_checks: Scratch-only fake-ops driver compiled against the frozen gate.c with ASan/UBSan, 18 edges: ready -> 0. 77 for child absent, child without a parent entry, keyboard node ENOENT, retired (stop, no error), faulted with error, uncommitted. 1 for null parent iterator, zero parents, two parents, a changed descriptor byte, interface 3, mouse wrong type, mouse stat error, route plus fault, fault without error, reserved nonzero, release failure. Zero ports left open in every case, and C and Python classify agree on all 18 records. Root's 24-boundary owned-right sweep, 7 release boundaries, 30000 differential cases and 5 killed mutants also pass in tests003.

notes.text: The gate compares the child's ReportDescriptor with the compiled-in approved reference (trackpad_reference.h a66853f0), not with this boot's T1 record. Equality with the same-boot acquisition still holds transitively: the kernel creates the child only after acquired == reference and publishes the acquired copy. The T2 qualification should still check, offline, that the T1 provider record's descriptor bytes equal the reference.

A PDM1SPITrackpad entry with no PDM1SPIHID entry in the IOHIDDevice set is classified 77 (clean absence of the parent), which is what the gate table says. It cannot become ready, and the supervisor stops before the compositor either way. Recording it as 1 (attribution) would be stricter. This is a policy choice, not a false READY.

decode() needs the 14 gate lines to be contiguous after CR removal. T1-002's 25 DL14 lines were contiguous under the same normalization, so single-process output is in practice. A kernel line splitting the block would make decoding fail closed.

scope: Read-only source/decoder review, receipt and immutable-source verification, binary reachability, and a scratch-only fake-ops edge driver. No edits, SSH or hardware.
